[P2] Release abandoned durable children from clock coordination

When a parallel with `minSuccessful: 1` completes its one-second wait branch while another branch invokes a durable handler whose step never settles, `releaseAbandonedInvokes()` deletes this handoff but leaves the child runner in `participants`. Its `isBusy()` remains true, so `advance()` refuses subsequent jumps—even after the caller returns. A later runner’s one-hour wait consequently takes an hour of real time. Release abandoned child runners and their descendants from clock-blocking participation when their owning context or caller completes, and add a durable-child variant of the existing unanswered-invoke regression test.
